content.title: Emma Stone's Shimmering White 2026 Oscars Gown Looks Even More Jaw-Dropping from the Back
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Emma Stone walked the 2026 Oscars red carpet in a shimmering white gownStone's Louis Vuitton gown was even more stunning from the backStone is nominated at this year's ceremony for Best Actress for her role in Bugonia Emma Stone is a vision at the 2026 Oscars! The actress, 37, glittered on the red carpet in a white hand-embroidered empire-cut gown with cap sleeves. The custom Louis Vuitton creation featured a modest square neckline in the front but dipped low in the back in a surprisingly sexy detail. The star also wore Louis Vuitton on her face, sporting the LV Ombres Eyeshadow palette in Beige Memento paired with the LV Rouge lipstick in Passport to Paris. Her copper bob was parted to the side and delicately curled at the ends for a glamorous twist on her signature cut. Emma Stone. ANGELA WEISS / AFP via Getty Stone is nominated for Best Actress for her role in Bugonia. According to The Hollywood Reporter, the star is now the youngest woman in history to reach seven Oscar nominations across her career. Streep previously held that record for women, per the outlet, since she was 38 when she scored her seventh nod in 1988. Still, Streep, 76, holds the record for the most nominations of any actor, 21 total. (She has won three times.) Emma Stone. Gilbert Flores/Penske Media via Getty “Thank you to the Academy for these nominations and to everyone who poured their hearts into Bugonia," Stone said in a statement on Jan. 22. "None of this exists without our director, Yorgos [Lanthimos]. I am forever grateful for our creative partnership and friendship." She continued, "I share this recognition with the beyond brilliant Jesse Plemons and our remarkable cast, crew and producers. To be in the company of all of these incredible nominees is a true honor, and I’m deeply thankful." Stone earned her first nomination, Best Supporting Actress for Birdman, in 2015. She went on to win Best Actress for La La Land and for Poor Things, and, between those victories, earned another nomination for her supporting turn in The Favourite. As a producer on Poor Things, Stone earned a nomination for its Best Picture nod too. Related Stories The actress has been turning out glamorous looks all awards season long. At the 2026 Golden Globes, she bared her abs in a butter yellow Louis Vuitton two-piece look made of a cropped sleeveless tank top and a beaded fringe skirt hanging right above her hips. She also debuted a refreshed "soft auburn" hair color courtesy of celeb-loved stylist and Schwarzkopf Professional’s U.S. creative director of color and technique, Tracey Cunningham. Kevin Mazur/Getty In an interview with Vogue, Stone said that growing out her hair after going bald for Bugonia "has been unexpectedly very fun." “The first three months were the hardest part because I wore a beanie constantly. It was very short and buzzed, and I found it just kind of boring to always be wearing a beanie. But once it got to pixie length, from then on, it’s been a really fun process. You get to try so many different styles.” See PEOPLE's coverage of the 98th Academy Awards, airing live on ABC and Hulu on March 15.
